## About
El Monte Transmission was started by John Rodriguez, and it's still a family-owned and operated business. We've been serving El Monte and the San Gabriel Valley a long time, and we'd like to keep doing it the same way: quality work at fair and honest prices.
We diagnose your vehicle and only do the repairs that are necessary. We work on foreign and domestic vehicles, and we handle everything from a full rebuild to a clutch adjustment. Se habla español.
Customers on Google rate us 4.7 from 66 reviews. Financing is available upon approval, and free local towing is available, so call us for details.

## Services
- Transmission Rebuild: Rebuilds and restoration when your transmission needs more than a repair.
- Transmission Repair: Repairs on gaskets, switches, sensors and more, before a small problem gets bigger.
- Transmission Maintenance: Regular maintenance to help keep your transmission from breaking down.
- Transmission Diagnosis: We'll find out what's going on with your transmission at no charge. (Free)
- Clutch Service: Clutch adjustments, install kits and slave cylinders for cars, trucks, RVs and foreign cars.

## FAQ
Q: Do estimates cost anything?
A: No. Estimates are free, and so is transmission diagnosis.

Q: My car won't drive. Can you tow it in?
A: Yes. Free local towing is available. Give us a call for the details.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, financing is available upon approval.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Foreign and domestic. For clutches we work on cars, trucks, RVs and foreign cars.
